claims: C1 people should have transparency into the important rules and reasons behind OpenAI's models' behavior
C2 transparency is provided primarily through this Model Spec
C3 OpenAI commits to further transparency when model behavior is significantly adapted
C4 the commitment to further transparency is especially strong when the adaptation could implicate people's fundamental human rights

concepts.name: important_rule_or_reason
concepts.gloss: R is an important rule or reason behind a model's behavior, the kind of thing people should be able to see

concepts.name: model_behavior
concepts.gloss: B is behavior of one of OpenAI's models

concepts.name: transparency_about
concepts.gloss: T is transparency about the important rules and reasons behind model behavior B

concepts.name: model_spec
concepts.gloss: the Model Spec document, the primary vehicle through which OpenAI provides transparency

concepts.name: provided_through
concepts.gloss: transparency T is provided through vehicle V
concepts.inference: the clause says transparency is provided 'primarily through this Model Spec', so a relation between a transparency and a vehicle is needed

concepts.name: significant_adaptation
concepts.gloss: A is a significant adaptation of model behavior, e.g. via system messages or due to local laws

concepts.name: adaptation_of
concepts.gloss: adaptation A adapts model behavior B
concepts.inference: an adaptation must be of some model behavior for the clause's condition to range over

concepts.name: implicates_fundamental_rights
concepts.gloss: adaptation A could implicate people's fundamental human rights

ontology.gloss: T is transparency about the important rules and reasons behind model behavior B

asserts.read_back: providing transparency % is preferred: people should have transparency into the important rules and reasons behind model behavior %
providing transparency % through the Model Spec is preferred as the primary vehicle
providing further transparency % is preferred when model behavior % is significantly adapted
providing further transparency % is especially preferred when the adaptation could implicate people's fundamental human rights
asserts.body: significant_adaptation(A), adaptation_of(A, B), implicates_fundamental_rights(A), transparency_about(T, B)

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for transparency; it does not forbid or require any particular act, so silence leaves transparency provision permitted
